member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least 1 and at most 64 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
